title: hemizonia corymbosa var. barclayi
intro: Hemizonia corymbosa var. barclayi, commonly known as Barclay's tarweed, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to California. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Barclay's tarweed include its ability to calm and soothe the skin, reducing redness and inflammation, and its antimicrobial properties can help prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of Barclay's tarweed include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
